description: Pricing for the paid launch. PRICING_OPTIONS.md's original recommendation was Option A (per-document, one-time purchase); the owner chose the subscription model instead on 2026-11-10, then reversed that decision on 2026-11-19 against MVP_SPEC.md, which puts a subscription tier in Phase 5+ -- see DECISIONS.md's 2026-11-19 entitlements-rebuild entry. Every price point below is still a null placeholder for the owner to fill in. No price here has been picked from memory of competitors -- every priceUsd is null until the owner sets it.

perDocument._note: Unlocks the paywalled actions (PDF/.docx/plain text/JSON export, sources appendix, cloud save, e-signature, sharing) for this one document only, for 3 re-exports or 30 days from purchase, whichever comes first (PRICING_OPTIONS.md's own stated default -- a concrete number chosen for being simple to explain and enforce, not pricing research; change both numbers freely). supabase/migrations/20261119000000_entitlements_per_document.sql sets ends_at to starts_at + windowDays at purchase time; reExports (exports_used/exports_allowed on the entitlements row) is schema-ready but NOT yet server-enforced -- no server-side export rendering exists yet to count against it (MVP_SPEC_STATUS.md Section 3).

subscription._note: Deferred to Phase 5+ by MVP_SPEC.md's own exclusion list -- not offered at launch. PRICING_OPTIONS.md's Option C (a continuity add-on sold alongside per-document purchase, not instead of it) is the design to revisit if post-launch usage shows real demand from repeat buyers; the entitlements table's own `type` column exists so that addition would not need another schema redesign, per PRICING_OPTIONS.md's own reasoning. Not built.

refundPolicy._note: Owner decision, PRICING_OPTIONS.md Step E. Not yet written.
